e04: E04 (emergence/disappearance) is incomplete by design at fixed K: births/disappearances cannot be distinguished from relabelling, so they are never reported. A6 lists only split/merge CANDIDATES (overlap >= 0.2) between aligned neighbouring clusters. A6 is a sensitivity analysis of temporal linkage, not cluster biographies.

formulas.share: share(cat,tid,m)=value(cat,tid,m)/value('Все категории',tid,m). Denominator is the 'Все категории' row, never sum6. No fillna(0).
formulas.standardization: z=(share-mu)/std, mu/std pooled over mask tids x 2023 months only (ddof=0), frozen transform of all months.
